claims.source_quote_ar: كيف فصل بين بعض المعدود وبعضه
claims.claim_ar: الفاصل بين «بَعْضَهُمْ» و«بِبَعْضٍ» وقع على نحوِ اعتراضٍ يؤدي إلى تأكيد المعنى
claims.claim_en: The separation between «بَعْضَهُمْ» and «بِبَعْضٍ» occurs as an objection/parenthetical interruption, functioning to emphasize and confirm the point.
claims.rhetorical_effect: الاعتراض هنا يعمل على التوكيد والتسديد (يشدّد المعنى ويبرز سبب الفصل بين المجموعتين)

warnings: Provided source chunks contain limited direct commentary on S6:53. The single extracted claim is based on Kashshaf fragment that explicitly discusses a separation between expressions of 'بَعْض'. Other rhetorical devices in the verse (e.g., interrogative force of «أَلَيْسَ», iltifat, or taqdim/takhir) are not attested in the supplied chunks and thus were not extracted.
